arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test single-digit hour with colon
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'
s = 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+1:00 b'
dt_r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
print('Result:', dt_r)
if dt_r is None:
    print('No match!')
else:
    tz = dt_r.fixed[0].tzinfo
    print('  Parsed tz:', tz)
    print('  Name:', tz._name)
    print('  Offset:', tz._offset)
"
